conviction_note: The print turns almost entirely on Q1 operating profit against an IFIS bar of about flat (Q1 ordinary 12,117m against 12,188m a year ago). No forecast revision is expected, since this company has filed one 業績予想の修正 in over ten years, and returns are already set. The monthly sales are public and show a +5.2% top line. Arithmetic from the company's own 短信 says flat OP needs gross margin up about 25-30bp, after two quarters of y/y GM decline. A same-quarter peer (Kusuri no Aoki) and Tsuruha saw gross margins rise. So the findings net to -0.2. The scaled number is p_up 47 on a 4.5% scale (-0.27): a mild lean, with the name's run of five down-reactions and a crowded margin long widening the scale but not the sign.
bar: Q1 (Jun-Aug 2026) consolidated ordinary profit consensus 12,117m JPY (IFIS via kabuyoho, https://kabuyoho.jp/report?bcode=3349, read 2026-10-13). One consensus source only; the company gives no quarterly guide, only H1: sales 582,700m / OP 20,780m / ordinary 22,180m (https://kabutan.jp/stock/finance?code=3349). Implied OP bar is about 11,570m, using last year's Q1 non-operating net of +543m. The bar has a single source, so the findings that depend on it are capped small.
positioning_check: JPX disclosed short register: 0.0% (no position at or above 0.5%), unchanged, as of 2026-09-29 (https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html, from the baseline). 信用倍率 8.59 (crowded margin long, scraped, in the baseline). No skew exists in Japan. Two large holders trimmed into September: Baillie Gifford 7.65% -> 6.62% (obligation date 2026-09-30, filed 2026-10-07) and Nomura AM 6.88% -> 5.86% (obligation date 2026-08-31). Run-up -5.63% over 20 days and -1.2% over 5 days. The stock was -2.1% intraday at the seal (6,252), but the window starts at today's close.

findings.finding: Q1 sales are already visible in the 月次. All-store sales were +4.1% in June, +5.7% in July and +5.9% in August 2026, about +5.2% for the quarter (about 286.6bn yen against 272.4bn). Existing-store sales were -0.6%, +1.2% and +1.4%, against a weak prior-year base. That is below the H1 plan's +8.5% sales pace and a sharp slowdown from the +11.6% of Mar-May 2026.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1 FY26 (sales +4.0%, OP +0.6%, EPS about 8% under the Yahoo consensus) was followed by an estimated -9.8% reaction (baseline history, 2025-10-15). The last five estimated reactions were all negative, by 3.5-9.8%.
findings.why_not_priced: It is largely priced. The monthly series has been public since 07-29, 08-31 and 09-25; the stock is -5.6% over 20 days, and the IFIS FY sales consensus (1,184bn) already sits below the company plan (1,190bn). What is left is only that the quarter confirms the slowdown, so it is sized near zero.
findings.independence: Same series for June and July: https://www.ryutsuu.biz/sales/s072971.html and https://www.ryutsuu.biz/sales/s083171.html (one source family; counted once).

findings.finding: SG&A deleverage arithmetic. Quarterly SG&A grew +9.2%, +9.2% and +9.1% y/y in Q2-Q4 FY26, and the store count is +6.0% y/y (1,717 at August against 1,620). With sales up about 5.2%, holding OP flat (the IFIS bar) needs gross margin of about 21.25-21.3%, against 20.99% in Q1 FY26. GM fell y/y in Q3 FY26 (20.88% vs 21.57%) and Q4 FY26 (20.66% vs 20.87%).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Margin-led near-flat profit prints were sold: Q1 FY26 OP +0.6% then -9.8%; H1 FY26 OP +1.6% then about -11% over three sessions (7,352 to 6,544, 2026-01-13 to 01-16, Yahoo tape); Q3 FY26 then -3.5%.
findings.why_not_priced: The IFIS Q1 bar (ordinary 12,117m, only -0.6% y/y) has not moved in four weeks (kabuyoho shows 46,804m FY unchanged on 10-09, 1 and 4 weeks ago). It sits above the company FY plan while the 月次 run below the plan's sales pace. Had the street done this arithmetic, the Q1 bar would sit nearer -5% y/y. The gap rests on an assumed SG&A growth rate, so this is inference and sized small.
findings.independence: Q1, H1 and 9M FY26 短信 (https://www2.jpx.co.jp/disc/33490/140120251009570542.pdf, https://www2.jpx.co.jp/disc/33490/140120251121507513.pdf, https://www2.jpx.co.jp/disc/33490/140120260217563822.pdf), all company documents of one series.

findings.finding: Peer read-through on gross margin. Kusuri no Aoki, a food-heavy drugstore reporting the same Jun-Aug quarter, posted OP +16.0% with an unexpected rise in gross margin and beat consensus by more than 1bn yen; the coverage reads this as drugstore price competition calming. Tsuruha's Mar-Aug OP rose 93% on gross-margin improvement. Cosmos did not react (6,211 to 6,198 on 10-02).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No clean prior case of a Cosmos GM surprise to the upside in the sample; Cosmos's own GM moved within about ±70bp y/y over the last eight quarters (短信).
findings.why_not_priced: Cosmos's tape was flat on the day the peer printed, and the IFIS Cosmos bar did not move. If the market had transferred the Aoki margin to Cosmos, the stock would have rallied with Aoki's 続急伸 and the Q1 bar would have been raised. Counter-weight, already netted into this size: Cosmos states it accepts lower margins to price low (EDLP) and is opening stores into its own catchments, so the transmission is a hypothesis.
findings.independence: Tsuruha H1 gross-margin improvement: https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=3391&b=n202610080256 (different company, different source). Against it: Sugi cut its FY OP forecast on weak seasonal goods (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=7649&b=n202610090344), but cosmetics are only 8.9% of Cosmos sales against 62.9% food.

findings.finding: Two large institutional holders cut stakes into the print. Baillie Gifford went 7.65% -> 6.62% (obligation date 2026-09-30) and Nomura AM 6.88% -> 5.86% (obligation date 2026-08-31), about 1.6m shares in total. Retail margin longs are crowded at 信用倍率 8.59.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Five consecutive estimated post-print declines (2025-07 to 2026-07), median abs move 4.78%.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced. The selling is dated to September and was public by 10-07, and the stock has since been flat to slightly up (6,327 to 6,392). It agrees with the baseline's margin-overhang lean (-0.47), so it adds little. Sized small.
findings.independence: Nomura AM report: https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=3349&b=n202609040634 (separate filing, same kind of evidence).

baseline_tension: The findings net slightly negative (-0.2), in line with the baseline's priced lean (-0.185, mostly margin overhang) and against nothing strong. The strongest positive the release could carry is a gross-margin rise like Aoki's and Tsuruha's, which would beat a flat bar at a year-low price after five sold prints (悪材料出尽くし). I looked for returns and a split and found nothing, so the positive case rests on margin alone.
lessons_applied: Rule 1 (a negative resting on a public 月次 series): the visible-sales finding was cut from -0.5 to -0.2, and the SG&A arithmetic finding, which is computable from public 短信 and 月次, from -1.0 to -0.6; p_up moved from 45 to 47

Rule 2 (negatives outnumber positives): wrote the strongest positive in baseline_tension and confirmed I had looked for returns, a split and peer margins; the peer-margin positive (+0.8) was left unchanged
Institutional-trim finding cut from -0.3 to -0.2, because it agrees with the sealed margin-overhang lean (core table: a sign that merely agrees with the positioning is smaller)
abs_move_pct left at 4.5: the lessons file does not touch scale, and no guidance change is expected
